item.title: Army Corps of Engineers Waives Day Use Fees at Recreation Areas in Observance of Presidents Day
item.description: PITTSBURGH — The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers Pittsburgh District will waive day-use fees at all district-operated recreation areas in observance of Presidents Day, Feb. 16. The waiver covers fees for boat launch ramps and swimming beaches. The waiver does not apply to camping and camping-related services, or fees for specialized facilities (group picnic shelters) and events. […]

item.title: Grampian Lions Club Welcomes New Member
item.description: GRAMPIAN- The Grampian Lions Club members welcomed a new member, Steve Livergood, into their club during the February meeting. Steve has been a Lion for several years and transferred his membership to the Grampian Lions Club. Receiving him into the club is T. Kirk Thorp, GLC President and sponsoring Lion Jim Bennett.
